newsitem.title: GERMANY: Delta agrees German job plan, hunger strike ends.
newsitem.headline: Delta agrees German job plan, hunger strike ends.

text.p: Five Delta Airlines workers who had been protesting job cuts called off their 11-day hunger strike Friday after Delta offered compensation packages for the 440 German employees it is planning to lay off, union officials said Friday.

Officials of the OeTV transport trade union said Delta had agreed to pay workers packages worth up to 250,000 marks ($149,000). The job cuts are linked to Delta's move to drop six European and three U.S. flights out of Frankfurt.
